::: {#def-ols}
#### Ordinary least squares

The **ordinary least squares (OLS) estimate**
[@wikipedia_ordinary_least_squares] of a model's parameter vector $\vparam$
is the value of $\vparam$ that minimizes
the [residual sum of squares](#def-rss):

$$\est{\vparam} \eqdef \argmin_{\vparam} \text{RSS}(\vparam).$$
:::
